featured_reviews.name: Vikas Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
After spending several years learning violin at Conversation Music Institute under the guidance of Finix Ramdas Sir, I can honestly say it has been an incredible journey. From the moment I first picked up a violin, Finix Sir showed remarkable patience and understanding, helping me build a strong foundation in music. Finix Sir has an incredible knack for explaining things in simple, understandable ways.His lessons are always engaging, mixing technical training with fun exercises that make learning enjoyable.
What makes Finix Sir stand out is his ability to connect with each student personally. He quickly spots areas where you need help and adjusts his teaching methods to match your learning style.His passion for music shines through in every lesson, inspiring students to push their boundaries and achieve more than they thought possible.

I am also learning vocals from Ms. Reena Gusain at Conversation Music Institute. She is an exceptional vocal teacher who brings incredible expertise and passion to every lesson. Her patient guidance and deep understanding of vocal techniques have helped me develop my music skills .

The Conversation Music Institute itself provides the perfect setting for learning. The classrooms are well-set up, and the positive atmosphere helps students feel comfortable and confident.

If you're looking to learn violin or improve your musical skills, I highly recommend checking out Conversation Music Institute. With institute's supportive environment, you'll be well on your way to becoming the professional musician you've always wanted to be.

featured_reviews.name: Elaine Gia
featured_reviews.review_text: I made my 7 year old daughter join the music school for piano in the month of Jan, had very high expectations that she will learn and continue her passion in music, but sadly I am writing this review to highlight how unprofessional the owner Mr. Akoi is and how he does not value small children's effort of coming weekly and learning inspite of their school and studies, and he did not even think twice to shut down the classes abruptly. He informed me via what's app that they will discontinue the classes and left us mid way. He being a professional teacher himself, he did not take the responsibility to give parents time to look out for some other classes, or even gave us any indication that he was closing the classes for good.It's very difficult to explain to a child as to why there are no classes and why they can not continue. It clearly discourages them from pursuing anything. What's app is not a mode of giving these kind of information. As a professional you need to be humble and have empathy for the child. I hope he has some remorse, and in future deal with situation like these with more empathy and consideration. No amount of explanation will justify of what you have done and how you have dealt with this delicate situation. MUSIC is a way for kids to express and release their already busy and loaded mind, which now clearly you have destroyed my daughters mindset. Thanks for the what's app message Mr. AKOI.
